Fe27 is the article's less-stoichiometric ferropericlase specimen. The average B1 atom-site representation preserves the oxygen-normalized bulk composition from Table 1; it does not claim to resolve the article's refined split of ferric iron between octahedral and interstitial sites. The lattice is the zero-pressure measurement made in the diamond cell without pressure fluid for the exact EOS specimen.
